description: Machine-readable expected outcome for every fixture in this directory. `verify-fixtures.mjs` reads this file and fails (non-zero exit) if any fixture's actual outcome does not match. Each entry's `type` selects which schema + semantic checks apply: "binding-record" or "audit-result". `reason_code` for a "reject" fixture is either a named semantic-check code (e.g. "manual_bind_requires_human_actor") or a raw schema-validator JSON-path (e.g. "$.binding_method"), same leading-token convention as agent-metrics/v1 and trace/v1.

fixtures.notes: pre_assigned_session_id: the wrapper's UUID nonce is the session_id itself.
self_reported_thread_id: session_id obtained after the fact from codex exec --json's thread.started event.
manual_bind with actor.kind == "human" -- satisfies the semantic requirement that manual bindings are attested by a human, not inferred.

binding_method="hook_based" is not in the v1 closed set -- hook-based binding was excluded after a spike found it silently skips binding when the agent's trust registration is missing (see docs/protocols/attribution-v1.md 'Rejected designs').
binding_method=manual_bind but actor.kind="agent" -- a manual bind must be a human's own attested action, not a system inferring one on a human's behalf.
All sessions exactly attributed, no violations, research_eligible=true.

One UNBOUND_SESSION and one MULTI_TASK_BINDING violation, correctly reported with research_eligible=false. tokens.total_measured(900) includes the unattributed/mixed sessions' usage as a measured total -- it is NOT a claim that all 900 tokens are attributable; only tokens.exact_attributed(400) is.
sessions.measured=0 (no sessions at all in this window) with tokens both null -- 'nothing happened' represented honestly, not as a fabricated 0.
One violation is present but research_eligible is declared true. Fail-closed is a MUST, not a recommendation a producer can override with its own judgment call.
reason_code="STALE_BINDING" is not in the v1 closed set (UNBOUND_SESSION | MULTI_TASK_BINDING | ORPHAN_USAGE | MEASUREMENT_INCOMPLETE).
sessions.measured=0 but tokens.exact_attributed/total_measured are declared 0 instead of null -- collapses 'nothing was measured' into 'zero was measured', which null-not-zero forbids.
